feed.title: Google Cloud: Service Usage
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Service Usage

entry.content:
As of July 30, 2026, support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enablement and consumer policies using the Service Usage v2beta API will be shut down.

For more information, see Feature deprecations.
entry.summary: Support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enablement and consumer policies using the Service Usage v2beta API will be shut down on July 30, 2026. This change affects how you manage MCP policies. For more details, please refer to the feature deprecations documentation.
entry.title: Deprecated: MCP policy management via Service Usage v2beta API deprecated

entry.content: Service Usage support for hierarchical service activation is available in Preview. This feature lets you enable and disable services across your organization's resource hierarchy.
entry.summary: Service Usage now supports hierarchical service activation in Preview, allowing you to enable and disable services across your organization's resource hierarchy.
entry.title: Feature: Hierarchical Service Activation Available in Preview

entry.content: Service Usage support for Hierarchical Service Activation is available in Preview. This feature lets you enable and disable services across your organization's resource hierarchy.
